description:
Delivery of 200,000 wooden stakes. Desired product is described in the product characteristics below:

The product will be used to anchor rigid seed tubes to the ground around our planted seedlings. The product includes a single component:

5/8” x 1 ½” x 24” Wooden stakes

  • Wooden stakes of the above dimensions, plus or minus 10% of the height and width dimensions, with one pointed end and one flat end. Pointed end must have length of 2-3”.
  • May be green or kiln dried.
  • Must be straight grained and have minimal knots or other defects. Knots shall not exceed ½” on the face and edge.
  • Shall not contains splits, pitch pockets larger than 1”, or weeping pitch pockets.
  • Must be rigid and free of defect to enable being driven into hard ground and to resist breakage.
  • May not be cracked.
  • Must not be treated with any chemicals.
  • Product must be delivered in bundles of 25 or 50 and secured on pallets to allow for loading/unloading with a forklift.
